project.title: Metagenomic data from DCDMH-pretreated waste activated sludge during anaerobic fermentation for enhanced short-chain fatty acid production
project.description: After anaerobic fermentation, sludge samples from the control and experimental groups were collected for metagenomic sequencing. Libraries constructed from genomic DNA were subjected to Illumina sequencing.
